title: Brand
intro: The Takere symbol brings together two hands that form the A and embrace a green heart: individualized care for your patient.

story.title: The symbol
story.body: The hands represent the health-care professional and the support network; the heart, the patient at the center of care. The green comes from health and hope; the black outline keeps it legible on any background.

assetsDescription: Official versions exported from the Design folder. The logo has a white fill and black outline: it works on navy, photos and light backgrounds.

wallpapers.title: Wallpapers
wallpapers.description: Official backgrounds for presentations, waiting screens and social media (16:9).

clearspace.title: Clear space
clearspace.description: Keep free space around the logo equal to the height of the heart (x).

guidelines.do1: Use the logo on the brand navy or on the official wallpapers.
guidelines.do2: Keep the original proportions when resizing.
guidelines.do3: Use the symbol alone in small spaces (favicon, avatar).
guidelines.dont2: Don't add shadows, extra outlines or rotation.
guidelines.dont3: Don't place the logo on low-contrast backgrounds.
